comparison.objective: Polish both faces of a blank safely on a running wheel, not commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Braces and presents work below a moving wheel centreline, flips it, manages frictional drag, and racks it.
comparison.success_condition: Three seconds contact per face, no snatch or fling, blank returned and released versus bounded stroke and rebound across impacts.
comparison.reason: Moving-surface contact control and snatch avoidance are a different tested ability.
